title: Performance and things going wrong
summary: This topic mixes praise for how the car goes and performs with a smaller set of complaints or worries about faults, controls, and display behavior.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise lively performance, smooth driving, and comparisons that make the car feel strong for its class.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe an early problem that needed repair and awkward operation of the air direction controls.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention worries about things going wrong, a display going dark, and settings reverting to default without enough context to judge overall sentiment.

limitations: This cluster mixes multiple subjects, including driving performance, faults, display blackout, airflow controls, and settings reverting to default.
Several fragments are too brief or context-limited to determine whether they reflect overall satisfaction or dissatisfaction.
The examples are stratified samples and are not representative estimates of the full owner population.
